hits.subject: Parts training ISZE
hits.body:
Dear Shelly,

 

We are pleased to inform you that the next ISUZU e-learning and information sessions covering EDI and Order Types & Procedures have been scheduled on the following dates:

 

*	Wednesday, 26 August
*	Wednesday, 23 September

 

During these sessions, we will explain the available order types, EDI possibilities, the implementation process, and best practices to help you optimize your ordering process with Isuzu Motors Europe.

 

To allow us to organize the sessions efficiently, please reply to this email and let us know which of the above sessions you and your colleagues would like to attend.

In addition, we would like to remind you of the previously launched EQ-Hit Parts Training. We kindly ask you to actively encourage all relevant dealership personnel to complete both the training and the online test if they have not already done so.

 

The training can be accessed via the following link:

https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=iWq0MnaF3Um94p3g8iE-yJV6ECXpY79Gt108WtczF09UMllWSk5PSDNWVVFPNlJDNkxaT0NWMllPRi4u&route=shorturl

 

This training has been developed to strengthen parts knowledge, improve the use of EQ-Hit, and ultimately support the growth of genuine parts sales throughout our dealer network.

 

Please note that completion of this training is mandatory and forms part of the requirements for the Isuzu Dealer Standards Awarding. Your support in ensuring that your dealerships participate is therefore greatly appreciated.

 

Should you have any questions regarding either the EDI sessions or the EQ-Hit training, please do not hesitate to contact us.

 

Thank you for your continued cooperation and support.

 

Kind regards,

 

 

 

Bart SYMONS

Business Developer
